text:
Hello everyone.

I have a B1 visa, and it expired in May. Because of the war, my renewal was not done on time. We were informed that there is an automatic extension until August, and my renewal appointment was scheduled for that month.

However, I have a flight planned for July, and I need to leave Israel and return before my appointment.

Has anyone been in a similar situation? How did you make sure you would not have any problems leaving and re-entering Israel with an expired visa that has an official extension from Misrad HaPnim?

Thank you very much for your help 🙏
